diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says Gnd, datasheet reading says VIN
diffs.evidence: Adafruit-TMP235-PCB 'TMP235 Rev A.brd' (the exact product 4686 board): signal GND = JP1 pad 3 + X4 (JST PH) pad 1 + X1 pad 2; VIN = JP1 pad 2 + X4 pad 2 + X1 pad 4; SIGNAL = JP1 pad 1 + X4 pad 3 + X1 pad 3. With the placements (JP1 at y=8.89 rot R270, X4 rot R90) the GND hole and JST pin 1 sit at the same end, so the physical row is Gnd, +V, Out (back silkscreen 'Gnd +V Out'), with Gnd at the JST-pin-1 end. VIN is the middle pin in every numbering, so it can never be pin 1; the second reading just copied the product page's Vin/GND/Out listing order, which is not the pin order.

diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says +V, datasheet reading says GND
diffs.evidence: Same Rev A board file: <signal name="VIN"> contains contactref JP1 pad="2" and X4 pad="2" (and C1 pad 1, TMP235 X1 pad 4 = VDD), so the middle header hole and JST PH pin 2 (red wire) are +V. GND is on JP1 pad 3 / X4 pad 1, an end pin, never pin 2.
